description: This is a test source file for the ImageHandler component in the OpenMRS project, containing unit tests for image handling functionalities such as supported views, MIME type retrieval, and saving complex data.

classes.name: ImageHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing ImageHandler functionalities, including supported views, MIME types, and image saving.

methods.name: shouldReturnSupportedViews
methods.description: Tests that the handler returns the correct supported views.

methods.name: shouldSupportRawView
methods.description: Tests that the handler supports the RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: shouldNotSupportOtherViews
methods.description: Ensures that the handler does not support views other than RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldRetrieveCorrectMimetype
methods.description: Tests that saving an image observation sets the correct MIME type.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldHandleByteArrays
methods.description: Tests that the handler can save image data provided as byte arrays.
